One. You hear a boy.
I could read simple books when I was five, but I could not ride a bike. My sister taught me to ride when I was seven.

Two. You hear a girl leaving a message.
Hi Jo. I found your diary in my bag. I took it by mistake after class. I will return it tomorrow.

Three. You hear a teacher.
The room was too noisy yesterday. Some pupils could not hear the instructions. Please listen quietly before starting today’s work.

Four. You hear a father.
You got up late this morning. Before bed tonight, check that your alarm clock is set for a school day, not the weekend.

Five. You hear a girl.
Yesterday I was afraid to talk to the new pupil. Then we drew together, and he was very kind. Now I feel happy about seeing him again.
